summary: SK Telecom filed a Form 6-K reporting its board's approval to establish and contribute capital to a new wholly owned subsidiary, SK Hyper Co., Ltd., to strengthen its AI data center business. SK Telecom will acquire 1,875,000 shares for total consideration of KRW 750 billion (approx. 5.79% of shareholders' equity). The acquisition is through cash installment contributions, with KRW 330 billion expected in July 2026 and the remainder by December 31, 2030. No put options or other agreements exist. This is an internal reorganization to create a new subsidiary, not a third-party acquisition or special situation. The filing is routine. No deal terms applicable.
